AcademyItem_dates_check.name: AcademyItem_dates_check
AcademyItem_dates_check.value: "AcademyItem"."startsAt" IS NULL OR "AcademyItem"."endsAt" IS NULL OR "AcademyItem"."endsAt" > "AcademyItem"."startsAt"

AcademyItem_published_check.name: AcademyItem_published_check
AcademyItem_published_check.value: "AcademyItem"."status" IN ('draft', 'review') OR ("AcademyItem"."slug" IS NOT NULL AND "AcademyItem"."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "AcademyItem"."approvedBy" IS NOT NULL)

AcademyItem_event_check.name: AcademyItem_event_check
AcademyItem_event_check.value: "AcademyItem"."kind" = 'LESSON' OR "AcademyItem"."status" IN ('draft', 'review') OR ("AcademyItem"."startsAt" IS NOT NULL AND "AcademyItem"."endsAt" IS NOT NULL AND "AcademyItem"."capacity" IS NOT NULL AND "AcademyItem"."venueName" IS NOT NULL)

CommunityStory_text_state_check.name: CommunityStory_text_state_check
CommunityStory_text_state_check.value: ("CommunityStory"."status" IN ('pending', 'published') AND "CommunityStory"."title" IS NOT NULL AND "CommunityStory"."body" IS NOT NULL) OR ("CommunityStory"."status" NOT IN ('pending', 'published') AND "CommunityStory"."title" IS NULL AND "CommunityStory"."body" IS NULL)

CommunityStory_length_check.name: CommunityStory_length_check
CommunityStory_length_check.value: ("CommunityStory"."title" IS NULL OR char_length("CommunityStory"."title") BETWEEN 5 AND 120) AND ("CommunityStory"."body" IS NULL OR char_length("CommunityStory"."body") BETWEEN 50 AND 3000)

CommunityStory_published_check.name: CommunityStory_published_check
CommunityStory_published_check.value: "CommunityStory"."status" <> 'published' OR ("CommunityStory"."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "CommunityStory"."moderatedBy" IS NOT NULL)

ContentNotice_length_check.name: ContentNotice_length_check
ContentNotice_length_check.value: char_length("ContentNotice"."contentRef") BETWEEN 3 AND 500 AND char_length("ContentNotice"."explanation") BETWEEN 20 AND 3000 AND ("ContentNotice"."notifierName" IS NULL OR char_length("ContentNotice"."notifierName") BETWEEN 2 AND 120) AND ("ContentNotice"."notifierEmail" IS NULL OR (char_length("ContentNotice"."notifierEmail") BETWEEN 6 AND 254 AND "ContentNotice"."notifierEmail" ~ '^[^@[:space:]]+@[^@[:space:]]+[.][^@[:space:]]+$'))

ContentNotice_identity_check.name: ContentNotice_identity_check
ContentNotice_identity_check.value: "ContentNotice"."category" = 'CHILD_SAFETY' OR ("ContentNotice"."notifierName" IS NOT NULL AND "ContentNotice"."notifierEmail" IS NOT NULL)

ContentNotice_status_check.name: ContentNotice_status_check
ContentNotice_status_check.value: ("ContentNotice"."status" = 'received' AND "ContentNotice"."outcome" IS NULL AND "ContentNotice"."decidedAt" IS NULL) OR ("ContentNotice"."status" = 'decided' AND "ContentNotice"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "ContentNotice"."outcome" IN ('action_taken', 'no_action', 'not_processed') AND "ContentNotice"."decidedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "ContentNotice"."decidedBy" IS NOT NULL)

EntraideMember_status_check.name: EntraideMember_status_check
EntraideMember_status_check.value: ("EntraideMember"."status" = 'active' AND "EntraideMember"."suspendedAt" IS NULL AND "EntraideMember"."suspensionReason" IS NULL) OR ("EntraideMember"."status" = 'suspended' AND "EntraideMember"."suspendedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "EntraideMember"."suspensionReason" IS NOT NULL AND "EntraideMember"."suspensionReason" IN ('HARASSMENT', 'MONEY_REQUEST', 'UNSAFE_BEHAVIOUR', 'INAPPROPRIATE_CONTENT', 'SENSITIVE_DATA', 'SPAM'))

EntraideOffer_note_check.name: EntraideOffer_note_check
EntraideOffer_note_check.value: ("EntraideOffer"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("EntraideOffer"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 280) AND ("EntraideOffer"."status" <> 'closed' OR ("EntraideOffer"."note" IS NULL AND "EntraideOffer"."closedAt" IS NOT NULL))

EntraideRequest_note_check.name: EntraideRequest_note_check
EntraideRequest_note_check.value: ("EntraideRequest"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("EntraideRequest"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 280) AND ("EntraideRequest"."note" IS NULL OR "EntraideRequest"."status" IN ('pending', 'accepted'))

EventRegistration_need_state_check.name: EventRegistration_need_state_check
EventRegistration_need_state_check.value: ("EventRegistration"."accessibilityNeed" IS NULL) = ("EventRegistration"."accessibilityNeedAt" IS NULL) AND ("EventRegistration"."status" = 'REGISTERED' OR "EventRegistration"."accessibilityNeed" IS NULL)

JobListing_length_check.name: JobListing_length_check
JobListing_length_check.value: char_length("JobListing"."title") BETWEEN 5 AND 120 AND char_length("JobListing"."city") BETWEEN 2 AND 80 AND char_length("JobListing"."description") BETWEEN 50 AND 3000

JobListing_apply_check.name: JobListing_apply_check
JobListing_apply_check.value: "JobListing"."applyMethod" IN ('url', 'email') AND (("JobListing"."applyTarget" IS NULL AND "JobListing"."status" IN ('withdrawn', 'taken_down', 'expired')) OR ("JobListing"."applyTarget" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("JobListing"."applyTarget") BETWEEN 6 AND 300 AND ("JobListing"."applyMethod" <> 'url' OR "JobListing"."applyTarget" ~ '^https://')))

JobListing_published_check.name: JobListing_published_check
JobListing_published_check.value: "JobListing"."status" <> 'published' OR ("JobListing"."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "JobListing"."moderatedBy" IS NOT NULL)

ModerationAppeal_kind_check.name: ModerationAppeal_kind_check
ModerationAppeal_kind_check.value: "ModerationAppeal"."appellantKind" IN ('author', 'notifier') AND (("ModerationAppeal"."appellantUserId" IS NOT NULL) <> ("ModerationAppeal"."noticeId" IS NOT NULL))

ModerationAppeal_status_check.name: ModerationAppeal_status_check
ModerationAppeal_status_check.value: ("ModerationAppeal"."status" = 'open' AND "ModerationAppeal"."reviewedAt" IS NULL) OR ("ModerationAppeal"."status" IN ('upheld', 'reversed', 'modified') AND "ModerationAppeal"."reviewedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "ModerationAppeal"."reviewedBy" IS NOT NULL AND "ModerationAppeal"."response" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("ModerationAppeal"."response") BETWEEN 10 AND 2000)

ModerationDecision_length_check.name: ModerationDecision_length_check
ModerationDecision_length_check.value: char_length("ModerationDecision"."facts") BETWEEN 10 AND 2000 AND char_length("ModerationDecision"."termsClause") BETWEEN 3 AND 300 AND ("ModerationDecision"."legalGround" IS NULL OR char_length("ModerationDecision"."legalGround") BETWEEN 3 AND 1000)

ModerationSanction_subject_check.name: ModerationSanction_subject_check
ModerationSanction_subject_check.value: ("ModerationSanction"."subjectUserId" IS NOT NULL) <> ("ModerationSanction"."notifierKey" IS NOT NULL)

ModerationSanction_kind_check.name: ModerationSanction_kind_check
ModerationSanction_kind_check.value: ("ModerationSanction"."kind" = 'warning' AND "ModerationSanction"."endsAt" IS NULL) OR ("ModerationSanction"."kind" = 'suspension' AND "ModerationSanction"."endsAt" IS NOT NULL AND "ModerationSanction"."endsAt" > "ModerationSanction"."createdAt")

ProAppointment_guest_idempotency_key.name: ProAppointment_guest_idempotency_key
ProAppointment_guest_idempotency_key.where: "citizenUserId" IS NULL AND "guestEmailHash" IS NOT NULL

ResourceAccessibility_verification_check.name: ResourceAccessibility_verification_check
ResourceAccessibility_verification_check.value: "ResourceAccessibility"."verified_at" IS NULL OR ("ResourceAccessibility"."reviewer_type" IS NOT NULL AND "ResourceAccessibility"."reviewer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ResourceAccessibility"."source_publisher" IS NOT NULL AND "ResourceAccessibility"."source_url" IS NOT NULL AND "ResourceAccessibility"."verified_version" IS NOT NULL)

StructureDuplicateDecision_primary_check.name: StructureDuplicateDecision_primary_check
StructureDuplicateDecision_primary_check.value: ("decision" = 'DISTINCT' AND "primaryId" IS NULL) OR ("decision" = 'SAME_ENTITY' AND "primaryId" IS NOT NULL AND "primaryId" IN ("structureA", "structureB"))

Testimonial_text_state_check.name: Testimonial_text_state_check
Testimonial_text_state_check.value: ("Testimonial"."status" IN ('pending', 'published') AND "Testimonial"."body" IS NOT NULL AND "Testimonial"."displayName" IS NOT NULL) OR ("Testimonial"."status" NOT IN ('pending', 'published') AND "Testimonial"."body" IS NULL AND "Testimonial"."displayName" IS NULL)

Testimonial_length_check.name: Testimonial_length_check
Testimonial_length_check.value: ("Testimonial"."body" IS NULL OR char_length("Testimonial"."body") BETWEEN 30 AND 1500) AND ("Testimonial"."displayName" IS NULL OR char_length("Testimonial"."displayName") BETWEEN 2 AND 40)

Testimonial_published_check.name: Testimonial_published_check
Testimonial_published_check.value: "Testimonial"."status" <> 'published' OR ("Testimonial"."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "Testimonial"."moderatedBy" IS NOT NULL)
